title: [Feature/Physics]: Interactive 2D Soft-Body Jelly & Lattice Blob Mesh Physics Simulator
body:
## Problem
Arcade platformers and puzzle games featuring slime, jelly characters, or bouncy trampolines currently use rigid rectangular or circular hitboxes. Without soft-body deformation physics, gelatinous characters feel static and lack tactile feedback.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Mass-Spring Lattice Mesh Engine (`assets/js/soft-body-physics.js`):**
   - Implements a 2D mass-spring polygon or lattice model with point masses, dampening springs, and interior pressure conservation.
   - Solves Hooke's Law and numerical integration with realistic squish, stretch, and jiggle dynamics.
2. **Curved Bezier Canvas Spline Skinning:**
   - Uses closed Catmull-Rom or cubic Bezier splines connecting outer perimeter vertices to render smooth jelly surfaces rather than jagged polyhedra.
3. **Interactive Pointer Physics:**
   - Allows players to poke, drag, flick, and toss the soft body with realistic deformation and wall rebound elasticity.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Stable 60 FPS simulation with zero numerical explosion during rapid compression.
- [ ] Volume conservation prevents unphysical collapse under external pressure.
- [ ] Reusable helper `ArcadeVerse.physics.createSoftBody(x, y, radius, verticesCount)` for game authors.

title: [Feature/Graphics]: Client-Side Pixel-Art Dithering & Retro Palette Quantization Studio
body:
## Problem
Catalog preview cards and game screenshots often use modern 32-bit true-color visuals that clash with the 8-bit retro arcade identity of the platform.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Dithering & Palette Reduction Laboratory (`assets/js/dither-quantizer.js`):**
   - Interactive developer lab and canvas filter implementing Floyd-Steinberg, Atkinson, and Bayer 4x4/8x8 ordered matrix dithering algorithms.
2. **Classic Hardware Color Palettes:**
   - Pre-calibrated authentic retro palette matrices: `Game Boy 4-Shade Olive`, `CGA Mode 1 (Cyan/Magenta)`, `Commodore 64 16-Color`, and `ZX Spectrum 8-Color`.
3. **Real-Time Canvas Processing Pipeline:**
   - Uses fast clamped `Uint8ClampedArray` direct pixel manipulation to process full-size canvas frames in under 4ms.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Real-time dithering execution without dropping below 60 FPS.
- [ ] 1-click preset selector and PNG export with embedded palette metadata.
- [ ] Zero external dependencies; 100% pure Vanilla JS math.

title: [Feature/Audio]: Web Audio Granular Synthesis Sound Scaper & Ambient Micro-Grain Lab
body:
## Problem
Sci-fi arcade games requiring atmospheric soundscapes (time-warp freezes, alien nebulas, black hole portals) lack deep ambient audio tools and are restricted to repetitive tonal bleeps.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Granular Audio Synthesis Engine (`assets/js/granular-sound-lab.js`):**
   - Chops procedural audio buffers into micro-grains (10ms - 60ms) and schedules continuous overlapping grain clouds using `AudioContext.currentTime`.
2. **Dynamic Granular Dispersion Controls:**
   - Controls for Grain Size, Grain Density (grains/sec), Spray Position Jitter, Pitch Dispersal, and Stereo Pan Randomization.
3. **Zero-Asset Procedural Audio Buffer:**
   - Generates initial source textures via procedural FM modulators and pink noise generators, requiring zero external WAV/MP3 downloads.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Smooth real-time granular synthesis without audio buffer underruns or clicks.
- [ ] Automated voice-budget management capping simultaneous grains at 32.
- [ ] Exports clean JSON parameter configurations for instant integration into game engines.

title: [Feature/Multiplayer]: Local Hotseat Turn-Based Game State Orchestrator & Transition Curtains
body:
## Problem
Local multiplayer games on a shared device (like Worms, Artillery duel, or retro board strategy games) require custom turn-management boilerplate, turn timers, and player hand-off curtains.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Universal Hotseat State Manager (`assets/js/hotseat-orchestrator.js`):**
   - Manages player rosters (2 to 4 players), turn order rotations, round counters, and active player state machines.
2. **Animated Pass-the-Device Transition Curtain:**
   - Displays an animated retro arcade curtain ("Player 2 Get Ready!") with secret move hiding, countdown timer buzzer, and keyboard focus protection.
3. **Match Summary & Podium Screen:**
   - Automatically computes per-round statistics (actions taken, damage dealt, time elapsed) and renders a retro winner podium.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Fully accessible via keyboard shortcuts (`Space` / `Enter` to advance turn).
- [ ] Clean event API: `hotseat.on('turnStart', callback)` and `hotseat.nextTurn()`.
- [ ] Zero state corruption during pause, resize, or tab switches.

title: [Feature/A11y]: Eye-Tracking & Head-Pose Pointer Navigation via WebRTC Landmark Mesh
body:
## Problem
Players with severe motor disabilities or quadriplegia who cannot operate keyboards, mice, or gamepads are unable to enjoy ArcadeVerse games.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Lightweight Optical Head Tracker (`assets/js/head-tracker-input.js`):**
   - Uses browser-native `navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia()` to capture player webcam input locally with zero server transmissions.
   - Computes head tilt angles and face centroid translation using high-speed optical frame-differencing algorithms.
2. **Virtual On-Screen Cursor & Dwell Clicker:**
   - Maps nose/centroid coordinates to smooth cursor movements on screen with configurable deadzone and sensitivity damping.
   - Implements a dwell clicker (holding cursor still for 800ms triggers an automated click or fire action).
3. **Privacy-Preserving Client-Side Guarantee:**
   - All frame analysis occurs strictly in browser memory; video streams are never saved or uploaded.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Real-time head tracking running at 30+ FPS with under 5% CPU overhead.
- [ ] Complete dwell-click indicator with animated circular progress ring.
- [ ] Immediate camera stream shutdown and hardware release upon modal close.

title: [Feature/Canvas]: Procedural 2D Raymarched Metaball Plasma Caustics & Water Ripple Sandbox
body:
## Problem
Aquatic and underwater arcade games in the catalog often suffer from flat, static backgrounds that fail to convey the dynamic refraction and light shimmering of authentic water surfaces.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Pure Canvas Procedural Plasma Caustics (`assets/js/plasma-caustics.js`):**
   - Implements an analytical multi-frequency sinusoidal plasma algorithm combined with raymarching distance fields to generate underwater caustic networks.
2. **Interactive Surface Ripple Propagation:**
   - 2D wave equation simulation allowing mouse movement, clicks, or falling game sprites to trigger spreading circular water ripples that refract the underlying caustics.
3. **Performance-Optimized Offscreen Buffer:**
   - Computes caustics at a retro 160x120 sub-resolution and smoothly upsamples to the main canvas using bilinear interpolation.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Smooth 60 FPS water ripple and caustic animation with zero memory leaks.
- [ ] Interactive parameter sandbox on `ideas.html` with wave speed and viscosity sliders.
- [ ] 100% Vanilla JS math without WebGL shaders or external libraries.

title: [Feature/Danmaku]: Parametric Spline Bullet Pattern Generator & Rose Curve Shmup Spawner
body:
## Problem
Shoot-'em-up (shmup) game creators struggle to author intricate bullet hell (Danmaku) barrage patterns, often settling for simple linear bullet spreads.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Algorithmic Bullet Pattern Engine (`assets/js/bullet-pattern-spline.js`):**
   - Provides mathematical parametric curve spawners: `Logarithmic Spiral`, `Rhodonea Rose Curves`, `Lissajous Knots`, and `Cubic Bezier Trajectories`.
2. **Object-Pooled Bullet Dispatcher:**
   - Integrates with an internal object pool to spawn and recycle 500+ simultaneous bullets without garbage collection pauses.
3. **Interactive Danmaku Pattern Designer Tool:**
   - A visual pattern playground on `ideas.html` with real-time controls for Petal Count, Angular Velocity, Bullet Acceleration, and Radial Spread.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Computes and renders 500+ active Danmaku bullets at steady 60 FPS.
- [ ] Exports 1-click JSON pattern presets that game authors can embed directly.
- [ ] Mathematical boundary checking and automatic bullet reaping outside the viewport.

title: [Feature/UI]: CSS 3D Anamorphic Isometric Projection Room & Tilting Vanishing Perspective
body:
## Problem
The main catalog grid displays game cards in traditional 2D rows. In high-end retro arcade hubs, games were displayed in three-dimensional physical booths that drew players into an authentic arcade environment.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Anamorphic 3D Perspective Room (`assets/js/anamorphic-room.js`):**
   - Uses pure CSS3 3D transforms (`transform-style: preserve-3d`, `perspective: 1000px`, `rotateX`, `rotateY`) to construct an anamorphic retro arcade room with checkerboard floors and neon side walls.
2. **Dynamic Vanishing Point Parallax:**
   - Shifts the camera vanishing point in real time based on mouse coordinates or device gyroscope tilt, creating a striking trompe-l'œil depth illusion.
3. **Interactive Game Cabinet Displays:**
   - Mounts live game preview canvases onto the 3D isometric cabinets with specular glare reflections.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Smooth 60 FPS 3D perspective tilt driven by CSS custom properties and `requestAnimationFrame`.
- [ ] Gracefully falls back to standard 2D grid for users with `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- [ ] Fully responsive and usable across mobile touch devices.

title: [Feature/Audio]: Pure Vanilla Audio Bitcrusher & Sample-Rate Reduction Lo-Fi DSP Node
body:
## Problem
Standard Web Audio oscillators produce clean, clinical digital sine and square waves that lack the grit, aliasing, and vintage lo-fi crunch of original 8-bit arcade hardware DAC chips.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Custom Bitcrusher DSP Node (`assets/js/audio-bitcrusher.js`):**
   - Implements discrete amplitude quantization (reducing 16-bit float audio to 1-bit through 8-bit resolution).
   - Implements variable sample-rate reduction (subsampling frequency by holding and dropping samples) to induce authentic vintage harmonic aliasing.
2. **AudioBus Master Insert Architecture:**
   - Can be inserted into the master audio chain or specific SFX sub-busses with a controllable wet/dry mix.
3. **Built-in Vintage Hardware Presets:**
   - Presets for `NES 2A03 (4-bit)`, `Game Boy DMG (8-bit)`, `Arcade Cabinet DAC`, and `Telephone Lo-Fi`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Zero perceptible audio latency or buffer glitches during real-time bit depth modulation.
- [ ] Pure Web Audio API script processor/worklet implementation with zero external audio packages.
- [ ] Clean node disconnection on game unload to prevent memory leaks.

title: [Feature/Lighting]: Dynamic Canvas Silhouette Shadow Puppet & Soft Penumbra Lighting Engine
body:
## Problem
Top-down adventure and stealth arcade games feature hard, artificial lighting cuts or no shadows at all, diminishing suspense and visual depth.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **2D Silhouette Shadow Caster (`assets/js/shadow-puppet-lighting.js`):**
   - Raycasts shadow volume geometry from dynamic point lights around polygon obstacles on the canvas.
2. **Multi-Sampled Soft Penumbra Gradient:**
   - Simulates light source radius by rendering a deep dark umbra core transitioning into a soft, alpha-blended penumbra shadow fringe.
3. **Light Color Temperature & Flicker Modulation:**
   - Supports colored neon light sources with procedural flicker (torches, sputtering fluorescent arcade bulbs, neon signs).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Casts dynamic soft shadows in real time from up to 4 simultaneous moving light sources.
- [ ] Maintains solid 60 FPS with zero memory leaks.
- [ ] Provides simple helper API `ArcadeVerse.lighting.addLight(x, y, radius, color)`.

title: [Feature/Input]: Chorded Keystroke & Stenographic Arcade Combo Decoder with NKRO
body:
## Problem
Fighting games and rhythm games rely on simultaneous multi-button chord presses (e.g. `J + K + L` pressed in the exact same millisecond window). Standard sequential `keydown` handlers often trigger false staggered inputs due to OS key-repeat delays.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **N-Key Rollover Chord Decoder (`assets/js/chorded-keyboard.js`):**
   - Captures multi-key chords within a configurable synchronization time window (e.g. 25ms - 40ms threshold).
   - Resolves simultaneous key clusters into discrete composite chord events (e.g. `CHORD_PUNCH_KICK`).
2. **Stenographic Combo Buffer & Rolling Dictionary:**
   - Matches incoming chord sequences against a registered chord dictionary with support for wildcard modifiers.
3. **Visual On-Screen Chord Diagnostic HUD:**
   - Visual indicator showing pressed keys, delta timing between key arrivals, and chord resolution state in real time.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Accurately distinguishes simultaneous chords from rapid sequential taps.
- [ ] Handles keyboard ghosting edge cases gracefully with customizable tolerance windows.
- [ ] 100% Vanilla JS event listeners with automatic teardown on modal exit.

title: [Feature/Haptics]: Virtual Gamepad Haptic Rhythm & Pulse Feedback Vibration Pattern Adapter
body:
## Problem
On mobile and tablet devices, touch controls lack the tactile feedback of physical buttons. Furthermore, rhythm games miss the physical impact of musical beats and combo milestones.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Universal Vibration Pattern Adapter (`assets/js/haptic-rhythm-adapter.js`):**
   - Wraps `navigator.vibrate` and Gamepad Vibration Actuator APIs (`gamepad.vibrationActuator.playEffect`).
   - Implements calibrated vibration patterns: `Soft Tap (10ms)`, `Heavy Impact (50ms)`, `Dual Heartbeat (30ms-50ms-30ms)`, and `Failure Buzz`.
2. **Audio-Linked Beat Haptics:**
   - Synchronizes rhythmic micro-pulses to on-screen game beats or combo multipliers.
3. **Accessibility Safety & User Preferences:**
   - Honors user mute/disable settings and respects system battery saver modes.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Works seamlessly across both mobile touchscreens (`navigator.vibrate`) and physical dual-rumble gamepads.
- [ ] Gracefully falls back without throwing errors on unsupported browsers/hardware.
- [ ] Toggle switch in the player settings modal to enable or disable tactile haptics.

title: [Feature/Physics]: Dynamic 2D Fluid Metaball Liquid Drop & Mercury Merge Physics Engine
body:
## Problem
Arcade chemistry, alchemy, and liquid-pour games currently draw hard circular particles that bounce like solid marbles rather than coalescing into flowing fluids.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Metaball Isosurface Liquid Renderer (`assets/js/metaball-fluid.js`):**
   - Renders 2D fluid particles using radial gradient alpha fields passed through a high-contrast threshold filter (`ctx.filter` or clamped pixel thresholding) to create smoothly merging mercury droplets.
2. **Viscous Surface Tension & Separation Physics:**
   - Simulates surface tension attraction when droplets touch, pulling them into cohesive liquid masses and stretching droplets into necks before splitting.
3. **Interactive Container Bounds & Tilting Gyroscope:**
   - Droplets flow, slosh, and collide against canvas boundaries and player-drawn obstacle polygons.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Renders 100+ fluid particles merging and separating at 60 FPS.
- [ ] Pure Canvas 2D implementation without WebGL shader requirements.
- [ ] Tested across touch pointers and mouse dragging.

title: [Feature/Catalog]: Client-Side Custom Game Shelf Collections & Base64 Library Exporter
body:
## Problem
With over 120 games in the catalog, players have no way to organize games into personalized shelves (e.g. 'Weekend Tournaments', 'Speedrun Challenges', 'Casual Classics') to share with friends.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Interactive Shelf Collection Manager (`assets/js/game-shelf-collections.js`):**
   - Allows users to create named shelves, assign custom neon color tags, and drag-and-drop games into custom order.
2. **Serverless Base64 URL Sharing:**
   - Compresses the player's shelf collection into a compact URL parameter string with 1-click shareable links.
3. **Clean LocalStorage Persistence:**
   - Stores custom user shelves under the `arcadeverse_shelves` namespace with automatic schema validation and JSON backup download.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Instant drag-and-drop shelf organization with accessible keyboard reordering alternatives.
- [ ] Compact Base64 sharing URLs loading smoothly without database dependencies.
- [ ] Zero interference with default catalog filters and search.

title: [Feature/Audio]: Web Audio Dynamic Pitch-Shifting Doppler Effect Acoustic Engine
body:
## Problem
High-speed racing and space shooting games have static audio pitches regardless of vehicle speed or distance, missing the thrilling frequency drop of passing objects.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Acoustic Doppler Simulation Engine (`assets/js/doppler-audio.js`):**
   - Implements the physical Doppler equation calculating apparent frequency based on relative velocity vectors between moving sound emitters and the player's ear position.
2. **Stereo Distance Panning & Air Absorption Attenuation:**
   - Couples Doppler pitch shifting with `PannerNode` stereo panning and high-frequency roll-off (biquad low-pass filter) as distances increase.
3. **Simple Game Developer API:**
   - Exposes `doppler.emitSound(soundPreset, sourcePosition, sourceVelocity, listenerPosition)`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Real-time Doppler pitch frequency shift without audio glitches or crackles.
- [ ] Realistic stereo sweep as vehicles pass listener coordinates.
- [ ] Fully documented with visual interactive acoustic sandbox on `ideas.html`.

title: [Feature/Security]: Audio-Reactive Spectrum Barcode & Inaudible FSK Watermark Encoder
body:
## Problem
Screenshot faking and score tampering in retro competitions undermine community leaderboard integrity.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Frequency-Shift Keying (FSK) Audio Watermark (`assets/js/audio-barcode-watermark.js`):**
   - Encodes a high-score verification hash into near-inaudible high-frequency chimes (18kHz - 20kHz) played at the game over screen.
2. **Visual Spectral Barcode Stamp:**
   - Encodes timestamp, game ID, and score signature into a discrete 2D barcode matrix embedded subtly in the bottom border of high-score snapshot cards.
3. **Client-Side Verification Inspector:**
   - A verification tool allowing maintainers to drop an exported audio clip or snapshot card to decode and verify authenticity.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Inaudible FSK encoding generated cleanly via standard Web Audio oscillators.
- [ ] 100% client-side verification with zero external cryptography dependencies.
- [ ] Non-intrusive to player gameplay and casual audio listening.

title: [Feature/Shaders]: Convex CRT Glass Curvature & Spherical Barrel Distortion Lens Mapper
body:
## Problem
Retro arcade cabinets possessed curved glass picture tubes (CRT bulbs) that naturally warped the image outward in a spherical convex bulge. Flat 2D screens miss this iconic physical arcade aesthetic.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Analytical Barrel Distortion Displacement Mapper (`assets/js/crt-lens-curvature.js`):**
   - Applies mathematical radial lens distortion math ($r' = r(1 + k r^2)$) to curve canvas pixel coordinates outward toward the screen edges.
2. **Phosphor Vignette & Edge Glare Reflection:**
   - Darkens the extreme curved perimeter with realistic CRT edge shadow vignettes and top-corner ambient reflections.
3. **Toggleable Performance Modes:**
   - Supports a high-performance CSS 3D spherical warp matrix mode for lower-end laptops, and full canvas displacement mapping for high-end systems.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Realistic vintage CRT glass curvature without external WebGL libraries.
- [ ] Solid 60 FPS performance with zero memory leaks.
- [ ] User setting toggle in the CRT options menu to adjust curvature intensity.
